title: Jazz as black heritage and invention out of frustration
summary: Blues grew from despair and jazz from being denied, inventing to outdo imitators.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: It's terrible for that to be the situation with an art and with artists. But do you suppose that possibly because of that, there is more feeling in jazz music than in a lot of other kinds because of the struggle that it's taken, that it represents (inaudible)?

Quite so. There's quite a possibility of just that, because blues singing, as a whole, came from despair and things that were wrong in peoples' lives, where people were tearing their hearts out, and singing it and putting it into musical form and fashion. That was part of the making of the blues and the way it still is, if you really want to listen to the blues. Well, the same thing is with jazz music.

One of the things about jazz music is most all jazz in every form is a black heritage. That can be proven. There's no doubt about it. Usually, new ideas come from jazz guys out of frustration and pride and other things that go toward trying to be inventive. That's what jazz is all about, is being inventive, to be able to take a common melody and turn it inside out and play it ten, 15, 20, 30 different ways and still have the same tune going, with the same progressions and the same tone pattern. A lot of music as it is is just -- comes from that way, from guys that have been denied and just do something else. Sometime it's almost a matter of fighting
back on the musical society, to play something that another guy can't do.

For years and years, there were probably only two or three or four jazz bands that ever made records and up until the '30s and '40s, there were no black bands that had recording contracts anywhere. So a lot of the things that have come out of jazz are just out of frustration and pure meanness sometimes, to just try to do something that nobody else can do, and black guys have so much pride about themselves that once the other people start finding out and start mimicking them, rather than go back and play what the other guy has learned how to do and is mimicking well, he'll get himself something new to play and go into a different phase, just to screw them all up, so they don't know where they are.
